title: Anti-recurrence sequences are linear plus automatic: an independent proof, with Walnut certificates for the rusty numbers d <= 15
description: A proof that for every positive linear form with k >= 2 the anti-recurrence sequence satisfies A_n - kappa n bounded and tau-automatic (Fokkink-Joshi / Clergyman's conjecture), including the rusty numbers for all d, with Walnut certificates for d <= 15. Found independently of an earlier unrefereed manuscript by L. Cundric (11 Oct 2026). Preprint, not refereed. Developed with AI assistance.
